RECIPE CARD - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
Document: AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
Revision: Rev 14 (current), effective 10/05/2023.
Batch size: 2,000 kg. Equipment: D-2, holding tanks HT-1..4, FL-2.
Steps
1. Charge 1,040 kg long-oil alkyd resin AL-60 (RM-101) into disperser D-2; start agitator
at 300 rpm.
2. Add 360 kg zinc phosphate anti-corrosive pigment ZP-40 (RM-110) over 10 min.
3. Add 0.4 kg soy lecithin (RM-150) together with the pigment.
4. Add 1.6 kg ammonium chloride (RM-118) pre-dissolved in 4 L water; stir 10 min.
5. Winter dose: from 1 November to 31 March add 3 kg bentonite anti-settling agent
6. Disperse at 1,400 rpm until fineness of grind is at least 6 Hegman (approx. 40 min).
7. Cool the batch below 40 °C before solvent letdown and record the temperature (hold
up to 30 min).
8. Let down with 320 kg white spirit D40 (RM-131) at 600 rpm.
9. Add 9 kg Co/Zr drier pack (RM-140) and 4 kg MEKO anti-skinning agent (RM-141).
10. Transfer to holding tank and rest the batch 12 h before QC sampling.
11. Filter through 50 µm bag filter and fill 20 L tins on line FL-2.
Controlled copy - the MES recipe is the master.
